caveat: An apparent inconsistency exists between the Use Table's "4 or more units" threshold and §5.1's "(3+)" heading for Special Permit review — flagged for follow-up. Stratford's code is hosted as a browsable eCode360 site rather than a single PDF, so there's no local mirror — but every figure below has now been independently re-verified against the live eCode360 text and carries a verbatim quote.

factors.label: Minimum Lot Size
factors.note: RS-1 (base district tracked): "Min. lot size = 40,000 sq ft"

factors.label: Parking Mandate
factors.note: RM-1: "Parking, multifamily (3+)" = 1.5 spaces/unit for a 2BR unit

factors.label: Demolition Delay
factors.note: Academy Hill Historic District: "Demolition delay = 90 days from permit issuance"

hap_score.methodology_note: Computed from the Variables table on this page, not from the NZA data below. Six weighted components (Multifamily Access 30pts, Approval Discretion 10pts, Minimum Lot Size 20pts, ADU Approval Pathway 15pts, Parking Mandate 10pts, Demolition Delay 15pts) are each scored against a fixed, published rubric from a specific cited fact above. Higher = more restrictive.
